prompt: What years was Antonio de Padua María Severino López de Santa Anna y Pérez de Lebrón vice president?
answer: Antonio López de Santa Anna was **never vice president of Mexico**. He was elected **president in 1833**, with **Valentín Gómez Farías** as vice president. Santa Anna served as president—intermittently—between **1833 and 1855**.
